newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Southeast seen attractive - report.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Southeast seen attractive - report.

text.p: Atlantic Southeast Airlines Inc is one of 30 stocks being traded below their inherent worth after the misfortunes of one of its main competitors, ValuJet Inc, according to the weekly financial tabloid, Barron's.
The tabloid said the regional carrier's earnings were expected to rise 24 percent this year and close to 15 percent in 1997.
Kimball International Inc was included in the list, compiled by FactSet Research Systems of Greenwich, Conn, it said.
The furniture maker's earnings were seen growing in 1997 and 1998, it added.
